{"sql":"SELECT COALESCE(g.Name, 'Unknown') AS genre,
       COUNT(il.InvoiceLineId) AS invoice_lines,
       SUM(il.Quantity) AS units_sold,
       ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity),2) AS revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
LEFT JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.Name
ORDER BY revenue DESC

UNION ALL

SELECT 'TOTAL' AS genre,
       COUNT(il.InvoiceLineId) AS invoice_lines,
       SUM(il.Quantity) AS units_sold,
       ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity),2) AS revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
LEFT JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
;"}

  SELECT COALESCE(g.Name, 'Unknown') AS genre,
         SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
  LEFT JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
  GROUP BY COALESCE(g.Name, 'Unknown')
)
SELECT genre, ROUND(revenue,2) AS revenue
FROM rev
ORDER BY revenue DESC

UNION ALL

SELECT 'TOTAL', ROUND(SUM(revenue),2) FROM rev;
"}
